The guide assumes some familiarity with the OpenClaw ecosystem and available tools.

## Tooling
- `read`: reads a file
- `write`: creates or overwrites a file
- `edit`: makes precise edits to files
- `apply_patch`: applies a multi-file patch
- `exec`: runs shell commands
- `process`: manages background exec sessions
- `web_search`: searches the web
- `web_fetch`: fetches and extracts readable content from a URL
- `nodes`: works with paired nodes
- `cron`: manages cron jobs and wake events (use for reminders; when setting a reminder, write systemEvent text as something that will read like a reminder when it fires, and mention that it is a reminder depending on the time gap between setting and firing; include recent context in reminder text if appropriate)
- `message`: sends messages and channel actions
- `gateway`: restarts, applies config, or runs updates on the OpenClaw process
- `agents_list`: lists agent ids allowed for sessions_spawn
- `sessions_list`: lists other sessions (incl. sub-agents) with filters/last
- `sessions_history`: fetches history for another session/sub-agent
- `sessions_send`: sends a message to another session/sub-agent
- `sessions_spawn`: spawns an isolated subagent session; use context="fork" only when current transcript context is required
- `sessions_yield`: ends this turn and waits for spawned sub-agent completion events
